chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: Adventurer! It is good to see you again.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.player: And you too, King. How fares the tree?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.player: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.player: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.player: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.text: And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-sharee.prompt: Start the Monkey Madness I quest?

steps.text: Narnode hands you a copy of the Royal Seal.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Please report to me as soon as you have any information.
Monkey Madness: Chapter 1 In which our hero finds themselves drawn back into Glough's web of deception and deceit.

steps.player: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.text: Are you ready to investigate the shipyard for me?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.player: What do I have to do?

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.text: Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.text: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again-.prompt: Start the Monkey Madness I quest?

options.text: What am I meant to do?

steps.player: What am I meant to do?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: They would have each flown a Gnome Glider.

chapter-1-trying-to-enter-the-ship-yard.speaker: Shipyard worker
chapter-1-trying-to-enter-the-ship-yard.text: Hey you! What are you up to?

chapter-1-trying-to-enter-the-ship-yard.player: I'm trying to open the gate!
I am on a special mission for King Narnode of the Gnomes.

chapter-1-trying-to-enter-the-ship-yard.speaker: Shipyard worker
chapter-1-trying-to-enter-the-ship-yard.text: Narnode? I don't believe you. He wouldn't send a human!
If the player doesn't have the royal seal:
If the player has the royal seal:

steps.player: Look, I have the Gnome Royal Seal.

steps.text: You show the shipyard worker the Royal Seal.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Wow. I haven't seen one of these since...

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: ... since Glough used to visit.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Anyway. Please step inside, [Sir/Miss].

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Hello. Do I know you? You seem remarkably familiar...

steps.player: Erm, no you don't know me.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: If you say so. Anyway, what do you want?

chapter-1-talking-to-the-foreman.player: Have you seen any of King Narnode's Royal Guard recently? They were meant to be doing ... some work in the area.

chapter-1-talking-to-the-foreman.speaker: Foreman
chapter-1-talking-to-the-foreman.text: I wouldn't know anything about that. You should see Caranock.

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.text: Who are you? Did Glough send you?

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.player: Glough? No. He has been forced to resign by the King.
He was plotting to start a war between Gnomes and humankind.
Anyway, I am here on a separate mission. I am investigating the mysterious disappearance of the 10th squad of King Narnode's Royal Guard. They were to carry out some work in the area.

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.text: Royal Guard? I know nothing about them. Absolutely nothing.

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.player: You have no idea why they mysteriously disappeared?

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.text: None whatsoever. What were they here to do?

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.player: They were to oversee the decommission of the shipyard.

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.text: Decommission the shipyard... I see. Well, we have had some seriously strong southerly winds of late. They may have been blown off course during flight.

chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-g-l-o-caranock.text: I shall personally see to the decommission. You should report to the King immediately.

chapter-1-talking-to-caranock-again.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-1-talking-to-caranock-again.text: Why are you still here? You should report immediately to the King!

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Thank you for doing this. What did you find?

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.player: I met a Gnome who goes by the name of Caranock. Do you recognise it?

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.text: The name sounds a little familiar, but it is nobody I know personally.

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.player: He calls himself a Gnome Liaison Officer. He seemed a little... odd

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Never mind that - did you find anything out about my 10th squad?

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.player: Caranock suggested they were blown off course by extreme southern winds.
I don't have any other information right now.

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Very well. I will now prepare some orders. You must convey them to my new High Tree Guardian, Daero.
Narnode begins to write strange glyphs on a scroll of paper.
Narnode hands you some handwritten orders.

chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-1-returning-to-king-narnode.text: You will find him attending to business somewhere on the Grand Tree.

chapter-1-talking-to-king-narnode-again.text: If you still have the orders:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: How goes the mission?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Yes, adventurer?

steps.player: You know those orders you gave me -

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: You've lost them?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Oh, it often happens. Luckily I had the foresight to write in a secret code on self-destructing paper.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here, take a another.
Narnode begins to write strange glyphs on a scroll of paper.
Narnode hands you some handwritten orders.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: Indeed I am - and you are?

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.player: I am an adventurer. I am currently in the service of your King.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: I see. You must be the individual who helped defeat my predecessor Glough. I hope you'll find me a more honest replacement.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.player: I have been asked to give you orders from King Narnode.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: Well hand them over here then.
If you don't have the orders:

steps.player: However, I appear to have lost them...

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Well you'd better retrieve them as soon as possible. Our enemies may extract sensitive information from them.
You hand King Narnode's orders to Daero.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: It is written in an old military code. Bear with me whilst I decode this.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: I hope you feel like a quest adventurer ...

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: ... because you are going to get one.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.player: Tell me what the orders say!

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: Given your recent performance of uncovering and neutralising a threat at the very extremes of the Gnome hierarchy, the King has decreed that you are to undertake a reconnaisance mission.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: You are to be taken far to the south of Karamja, further than any Gnome has purposely travelled before. You are to investigate Caranock's claim that Garkor's squad were blown off course.

chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-daero.text: You must really have impressed the King in the past.

options.text: What lies to the south of Karamja?

steps.player: What lies to the south of Karamja?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We do not know. Initial reports spoke of a large atoll populated by monkeys.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: From what I have heard, not quite like those monkeys...

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: It is my responsibility to make arrangements for your mission. We will shortly visit a colleague of mine who will be accompanying you.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: I am afraid not. I must remain here to safeguard the Grand Tree. I will assign a Gnome agent to travel with you.

options.text: Why did the King send a squad of the Royal Guard?

steps.player: Why did the King send a squad of the Royal Guard?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: The Royal Guard is composed of particularly elite soldiers who have proven themselves in battle. They are duty bound to protect the Grand Tree its King and his interests.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: In the face of danger, they can more than take care of themselves.

steps.player: So the King worries we have come across an equally formidable foe?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: He worries about this, yes.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Sergeant Garkor holds the command of the 10th squad. As a soldier, he is extremely able. If his men are in trouble, he will be tirelessly working to save them.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You should aim to make contact with him.

options.text: Why are the 10th squad so famous?

steps.player: Why are the 10th squad so famous?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: They are, as you humans might say, the best of the best. As well as Sergeant Garkor, they have in their company a High Mage, two sappers and battle hardened foot soldiers.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You might consider the role as that of an engineer. Or perhaps of a munitions expert.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: I have never heard of him. According to the report you made to the King, he is the Gnome Liaison Officer at the eastern Karamja shipyard.

options.text: What is a Gnome Liaison Officer?

steps.player: What is a Gnome Liaison Officer?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: It was a position Glough introduced. Gnome Liaison Officers are in general responsible for coordinating activities between Gnomes and other beings in our remote operations.

options.text: I'm not so sure about Caranock...

steps.player: I'm not so sure about Caranock...

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: In what way?

steps.player: I do not know. He just seemed a little suspicious. He was very keen to see me leave.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: I do not know him; he is from before my time. Glough would presumably have hand picked him.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: I must first introduce you to a colleague of mine who will be accompanying you on your mission.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: His name is Flight Commander Waydar.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We must go now and meet Waydar. For security reasons I must ask you to wear a blindfold.
You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The player is transported to the Underground Military Glider Hangar.

options.text: I work better on my own...

steps.player: I work better on my own...

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Tough. You will be working with Flight Commander Waydar.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We must go now and meet Waydar. For security reasons I must ask you to wear a blindfold.
You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The player is transported to the Underground Military Glider Hangar.

chapter-1-talking-to-daero-again-before-.player: I have been asked to give you orders from King Narnode.

chapter-1-talking-to-daero-again-before-.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-talking-to-daero-again-before-.text: Well hand them over here then.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.text: Sorry, I am not authorised to talk to you.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-interac.text: You do not know what you are doing.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Welcome, adventurer, to the Underground Military Glider Hangar.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.player: Wow! Why would Gnomes need such a place?

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: We do not, if the truth be told. This hangar was part of Glough's contingency planning. Had the attacks by land and sea failed, he would have turned to air.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: It is fortunate indeed that you managed to expose him. The military gliders in this hangar are a prototype for a much refined version of the standard variety we currently use.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Let me introduce you to Flight Commander Waydar.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Flight Commander Waydar, I would like you to meet [player name].

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Greetings High Tree Guardian.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: And greetings to you too, visitor.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Not just any old visitor Waydar; this is the person who exposed Glough and defeated his demon.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: I see. Well, there are no more demons left here.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Quite. [He is/She is/They are] now on a secret mission for the King.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: As you know, the 10th squad went missing during their mission to decommission the eastern shipyard of Karamja.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: We still do not know what happened, but evidence suggests they were blown far off course to the south.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Their standard gliders must have fallen prey to the tropical weather.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: When reinitialisation has been completed, you are to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name] and accompany [him/her/them] on the mission.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: We are no closer to reinitialising sir - the code is too hard. It is likely the only person who could do it is Glough.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: That Gnome is never stepping foot in this hangar again. He always was and still is a menace. Do you understand me?

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Yes sir.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Very well. Notify me when you have managed to reinitialise.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: [player name], you will have to wait till reinitialisation is complete.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.text: Hello again, adventurer. Would you like to return to the hangar?

steps.text: You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The player is transported to the Underground Military Glider Hangar.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Very well. Return to me when you do.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-selecti.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-selecti.text: There is a teleporter round the corner. You must use this.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-searchi.text: This crate is full of ...  spare controls!

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-searchi.prompt: Do you wish to take one?

steps.text: Spare controller

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We try to ensure the location of the hangar remains a secret. If you must know something, then know that it lies directly beneath the Gnomeball pitch. However, I cannot reveal the location of its entrance.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: There is a teleporter round the corner.

options.text: How do I return here later?

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Come and find me on the Grand Tree. I will probably be at the bar.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Glough left a code on the facility which periodically needs to be entered if we wish to maintain the supply of power.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Without going through this process of reinitiliasation, we cannot power the mechanism which deploys the millitary gliders.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: As Daero said, they are a prototype for a new version of glider. They are reinforced yet are built out of lighter materials. They can fly much faster and for longer.

options.text: Why are the gliders folded against the wall?

steps.player: Why are the gliders folded against the wall?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: It is the most compact way to store them. Unfortunately, they will remain like that until they are powered. We can only fully power the hangar when reinitialisation has been completed.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: I cannot be sure. It is a difficult code; it may happen the next instant - then again it may not.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: You could even have a go at solving the code yourself.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: The code must be entered at the red control panel just by the wall over there.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.player: I've been told to wait for reinitialisation of the hangar. They mentioned your name.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.speaker: Glough
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.text: Of course they would. I'm the only one who knows how to do it.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.player: This is really quite embarrassing, but...

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.speaker: Glough
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-talking.text: Let me guess, you need my help...

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: I am able to remotely reinitialise...

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: It will cost you...

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: Oh... just a measly 200,000 coins. Yes, I think that will do me nicely.
If the player doesn't have 200,000 coins on them

steps.player: I don't have that kind of money on me right now.

steps.text: If the player has at least 200,000 coins on them

options.text: Ok then. You win again, Glough.

steps.player: Ok then. You win again, Glough.

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: It's been a pleasure doing business with you.

steps.player: Indeed. I wish I could say the same for you.

options.text: No, I'd rather skin a monkey than take your help!

steps.player: No, I'd rather skin a monkey than take your help!

steps.speaker: Glough
steps.text: You don't know how to do that yet!

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Well done, adventurer. You have managed to break Glough's code. Now the process of reinitialisation is complete, you can truly begin your journey into the unknown.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.player: I've had some practice in the past.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: You are clearly a human of many talents.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Flight Commander Waydar, now that reinitialisation is complete, I order you to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name]

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Yes sir.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: You are to safeguard [him/her/them] on this potentially dangerous mission.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: Understood.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: [player name], speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-speakin.text: And ... good luck.

chapter-1-the-underground-hangar-upon-so.text: As you slide the final piece into place you begin to hear a low rumbling sound...
A cutscene plays as the screen shakes, showing the military gliders unfolding.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: Well done on breaking the code. You should speak to the High Tree Guardian.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: [player name], speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Daero
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: Speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: You should stock up well on food before our journey. I can carry only enough provisions for myself.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: I'd be careful of the local fauna too - I've heard the bite is far worse than any noise they make.

chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-speaking-to-waydar-after-solvi.text: Do you wish to fly right now?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.player: Not yet. I'll be back later.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Waydar
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: I am not sure. We appear to have landed where the 10th squad crashed. The number of gnome gliders is correct. Unfortunately for them, it appears that none of their gliders survived the collision.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.player: We are on a mission for King Narnode Shareen. I am [player name] and this is Flight Commander Waydar.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: What business do you have here?

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.player: We are to investigate the disappearance of the 10th squad of the Royal Guard. Am I right in suspecting that you, Lumdo, are a member of the 10th squad?

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: I might be. Do you have any way to prove that you are who you say are?
If the player still has the royal seal:

steps.player: I have the Gnome Royal Seal.

steps.text: You show Lumdo the Royal Seal.

steps.speaker: Lumdo
steps.text: I see. Sorry for my distrust.

steps.player: We flew here on a military gnome glider. Is that not proof enough?

steps.speaker: Lumdo
steps.text: I suppose it is. Sorry for my distrust.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.player: So are you Lumdo of the 10th squad?
Where are the rest of your squad? Where is your Sergeant?

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: Let me begin at the beginning, human.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: We were on our way to decommission Glough's old ship building facilities in eastern Karamja, as you probably know. However, we obviously chose the wrong season to fly.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: We were one gnome to a glider, so each was extremely light. Like leaves in a wind, we were blown south before we even landed on that island.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: Yes. The winds drove us into the treetops, which destroyed the canvas of our gliders. We dragged what remained of the gliders out onto this beach.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: Whilst we were falling, Sergeant Garkor noticed a large populated atoll to our west. You cannot see it from here, but it is within sailing distance.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: We spent time gathering enough wood to fashion two boats. The Sergeant took the rest of the 10th squad in the larger of the boats to explore the island and to search for potential glider launch sites.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.player: Presumably you are to guard the gliders until they return?
You must take us to the island. I have orders from the High Tree Guardian to make contact with your Sergeant.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: And I have orders from the Sergeant to stay here.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-speaki.text: I will not take orders from you.

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-talkin.player: Will you take me to the atoll?

chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-talkin.speaker: Lumdo
chapter-1-landing-on-crash-island-talkin.text: I am under direct orders to remain here.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: During our descent I noticed a large populated island far to the west. I suggest we try and make our way there.

options.text: Do you recognize the gnome on the beach?

steps.player: Do you recognize the gnome on the beach?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: If I recall correctly, which I probably do, he is Lumdo of the 10th squad. I imagine he has been left to guard their gliders.

options.text: Can you take me back to your kingdom?

steps.player: Can you take me back to your kingdom?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: Let me remind you that we are on a mission for King Narnode. We must attend to this mission.

steps.player: My mission involves leaving this island!

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: This is highly irregular.
The player is transported back to the Tree Gnome Stronghold, south of the gnome ball field.

options.text: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island...

steps.player: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island...

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: What is the problem?

steps.player: He claims to be under direct orders from Garkor to guard their gliders until the rest return.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: His zeal in this matter is to be expected. The Royal Guard - in particular the 10th squad - are renowned for their fierce loyalty.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: I would rather not get involved. My mission is to protect you.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: You are becoming tiresome, human. As you wish.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: Foot soldier Lumdo of the 10th squad.

steps.speaker: Lumdo
steps.text: Yes?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: I am Flight Commander Waydar. I believe you are under direct orders from your Sergeant to guard these gliders?

steps.speaker: Lumdo
steps.text: That is correct, Commander.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: I need not remind you that I outrank Garkor. As of this instant, your orders are to convey the human to the atoll and remain there until [he needs/she needs/they need] to return.

steps.speaker: Lumdo
steps.text: Garkor will not be pleased!

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: Then he can take up his issues with me personally.

steps.player: Waydar! Will you not accompany me to the island?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: No. After all, somebody has to look after the gliders.

steps.player: But it is your mission to protect me!

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: Enough. Return here when you are done.
Meanwhile, far away in Karamja...

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: The workers are getting restless, Caranock.

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: I know...

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: All this talk of Glough being replaced doesn't bode well for ... how shall I put this ... their morale.

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: Look, I know.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Those are all men with children to feed. Famished families. Worried wives. All of us rely on this shipyard.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: If something isn't done soon, there'll be revolt. And I won't be able to stop it.

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: Stop worrying. I'm working on something -

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: What something? You're always working on something. All we ever hear is bad news.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: First, Glough disappears. Then news of a missing squad of the Royal Guard in our area. And what about that human sent by the King?

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: The human means nothing. If it becomes too much trouble, I will simply have it ... removed. In the meantime, let it continue to search for that blasted 10th squad.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: I am still worried. What am I meant to tell the men?

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: Stop worrying. I'm working on something - Glough left a few of his agents in the Gnome airforce.

steps.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
steps.text: For now, tell your men to continue work on the battleships. Give me some time.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: I hope you're right, Caranock, for your sake. My sake. For all of our sakes...
Monkey Madness: Chapter 2 In which our hero finds themselves engaging in severe quantities of monkey business.

chapter-2-talking-to-waydar-in-the-bunke.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-talking-to-waydar-in-the-bunke.text: Shall we return to Crash Island?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.player: Not yet. I'll be back later.

options.text: Are you sure you cannot come to the island?

steps.player: Are you sure you cannot come to the island?

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: I am sure.

options.text: I need to return to your kingdom.

steps.player: I need to return to your kingdom.

steps.speaker: Waydar
steps.text: As you wish...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumbo-on-crash-isla.player: Can you take me back to Ape Atoll?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumbo-on-ape-atoll.player: Can you take me back to Crash Island?

chapter-2-approaching-the-bamboo-gate.text: You have been hit by poisoned arrows and knocked out!

chapter-2-approaching-the-bamboo-gate.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-approaching-the-bamboo-gate.text: Look - a newcomer. I'd say let me be the first to welcome you to Ape Atoll, but I see you've already met the welcoming party...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.player: I am in the service of King Narnode Shareen. I have been sent here to locate the missing 10th squad of the Royal Guard.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Well we're certainly missing home, I'll give you that.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.player: How long have you been here?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Oh, not for too long ... The jail guards keep us entertained every now and then too.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: That's right Lumo. Remember the time when they got all confused when changing shifts?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Oh yeah. Trefaji and Aberab - they're as dense as bricks. They do give mighty punches though.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Indeed. My backside is still a little sore...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: I turned around at the wrong time...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Now, now lads, watch your language. You'll have to excuse them, human, they're only soldiers!

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: So human, what can we do for you?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.player: Well I suppose I ought to help you escape.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: No, it's alright, laddie, we quite like it in here.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Do your best to ignore him...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: To be fair human, you're not much help stuck in there.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.player: Well how do I get out?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: Well, you can try picking the lock on your door. Watch out for the guards though.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo.text: We've been trying to pick ours but we haven't been able to do so yet.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: First time talking to Lumo again:

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: So human, what can we do for you?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: What can I do for you, human?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.player: Well I suppose I ought to help you escape.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: No, it's alright, we quite like it in here.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: Do your best to ignore him...

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: To be fair human, you're not much help stuck in there.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.player: Well how do I get out?

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: Well, you can try picking the lock on your door. Watch out for the guards though.

chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.speaker: Lumo
chapter-2-talking-to-lumo-again.text: We've been trying to pick ours but we haven't been able to do so yet.

chapter-2-talking-to-bunkdo.speaker: Bunkdo
chapter-2-talking-to-bunkdo.text: What are you looking at then? Never seen a Gnome in a Monkey jail before?

chapter-2-talking-to-bunkdo.player: Not before I came here, no...

chapter-2-talking-to-carado.speaker: Carado
chapter-2-talking-to-carado.text: Well I'm not complaining - this jail cell is larger than my room in the Grand Tree! It is a little sparse however...

chapter-2-talking-to-carado.player: We'll get you out of there soon enough.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: And another one ... eats the dirt.

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: The phrase is 'bites the dust' Lumo...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: You know, we could try and break out ourselves.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: No... don't be silly. We're here to be rescued, after all.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Carado - are you thinking what I'm thinking?

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: Only if it involves 3 tonnes of ice-cream, a helium balloon and an inflatable pink gorilla...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: ... a 'no' would have sufficed.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Ouch. That must have hurt.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: ... and that completes our tour of the Jail of the Future. Please remember to use your conveniently located and totally pickable cell-door to exit.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: and B - I - N - G - O. I win!

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Bunkdo?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Do you ever look up at the stars at night and think about just how insignificant all of this is?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Stars? You can look UP??

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: And I thought 'night' was just a rumour...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Bunkdo?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Don't you ever get tired of, you know, wandering around?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: No. I for one happen to like standing bolt upright all of the time.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: sigh*

options.condition: If the player does not have a dragon sq shield equipped:

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Aww, I lose. Let's play something else.

options.condition: If the player has a dragon sq shield equipped:

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Wow. Somebody with a Dragon Square Shield. I win this game too!

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Bah. I hate bingo.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Those cheerleaders down the Gnomeball pitch...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Yeah I know the ones you mean...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Mmmmm hmmmm.

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: They're a bit short, ain't they?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Carado, they're gnomes!

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Darn you, Carado - you always get the large jail cells.

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: That is so not true. What about the time in Draynor?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: The Prince Ali thing? We all shared a cell that time.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: And that time in Varrock?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Yeah yeah, OK.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Hey guys, look who's here.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: ... and please remain prone until the room has come to a complete stop.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Hey look, they've come round!

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Have you noticed how they all look the same?

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: And they all seem to have the same clothes...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Spooky.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Bunkdo?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: You know - I've noticed something.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: What's that?

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: No matter how many monkeys these people seem to kill, there are never any fewer of them...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: That's just the Way of the World, Lumo.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: We are indefatigable Gnomes...

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: And we really likes our homes...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: If you pick with us a fight...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: You may well just might...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Find yourself without no bones!

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: ... and then the chicken said to the farmer: 'It was an aspirin!'

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: That has to be the worst joke I've ever heard...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Have we seen this one before?

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: I'm not sure - I'm beginning to lose track.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: You know, you should really try to avoid being captured.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: I think [he/she] knows that Lumo...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: ... and that's how I saved Narnode from the fire-breathing gnome-eating lizard-dragon-king of Jool.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: You know - everytime I hear that story it seems less and less convincing...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Look at that Bunkdo, [he/she/they] almost looks like they're praying.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: [player name], [player name], he's our man! If he can't do it, nobody can!
If the player is male:

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: I don't think that's helping, Lumo.
If the player is female:

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Er Lumo, it's a she.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Oh my god - [he's/she's/they've] been through here ten times now.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: And which god would that be, eh?

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: You know what I mean...

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Fifteen times ... wait: is it fifteen?

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: Yup, it sure is.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: I'm beginning to lose count now.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Twenty times! Give this kid an applause!

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Lumo, you're beginning to irritate me. Imagine what it's like for them.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: Fifty times a loser! I don't believe it!

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: Wahey - party hats all round!

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: I was only kidding...

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: One hundred times... It's just not real anymore.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: I think we should give [him/her] a prize.

steps.speaker: Lumo
steps.text: You're right. I know just the thing.

steps.speaker: Bunkdo
steps.text: No... not the..

steps.speaker: Carado
steps.text: Monkey corpse stuffed with seaweed!?
Lumo throws you a seaweed stuffed monkey corpse.

chapter-2-talking-to-karam.speaker: Karam
chapter-2-talking-to-karam.text: That depends on who is asking...

chapter-2-talking-to-karam.player: I am in the service of King Narnode Shareen. I have been sent here to locate the missing 10th squad of the Royal Guard.

chapter-2-talking-to-karam.speaker: Karam
chapter-2-talking-to-karam.text: I see. As you can see, this is a dangerous place to be.

chapter-2-talking-to-karam.player: It certainly is ... who are you?

chapter-2-talking-to-karam.speaker: Karam
chapter-2-talking-to-karam.text: Karam, 10th squad, Royal Guard. High Assassin at your service.

steps.speaker: Karam
steps.text: I am thinking of a way to free my friends. In the meantime, I am helping those who further my cause.

steps.speaker: Karam
steps.text: I have been gifted by Zooknock, our squad mage. I have saved his life on a number of occasions.

steps.player: Is there any way I could be like that?

steps.speaker: Karam
steps.text: Your best chance is to hide in this grass, human.

steps.speaker: Karam
steps.text: I move quickly.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: A fine day you have chosen to visit this hellish island, human.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: Good day to you too Sergeant. I've been sent by your King Narnode to -

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious disappearance of my squad. Yes, I know.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: Why do you need a human?

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: There is more going on than meets your eye, human. Did you not find it strange that an entire squad be sent to decommission a shipyard?

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Indeed. But there are more pressing matters at hand. Three of my squad have been captured and placed in the jail. They are watched over by somewhat overpowering guards.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Before we can resume our original mission we must rescue them.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: I know about the guards - I had to sneak out between the change of shifts.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Trust me; we too have considered this, but whilst it is possible for one, it is near impossible for three.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My, assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: I remain here so that I may overhear Awowogei's plans.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: The self-proclaimed ruler of the island. I have been listening to him for some time now. I believe we will incur a minimum of casualties if we have an insider - a monkey working for us.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: Have you seen these monkeys? You could never convince them to work for you!

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: I wasn't suggesting convincing them, human, but you.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: Don't be ridiculous! I'm a human - not a monkey!

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Do not be so sceptical ... you humans are considered to be quite closely related to monkeys.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Go and see my squad mage, Zooknock. Tell him I have asked you to be 'disguised' as a monkey so that you may infiltrate the village. As you will see, he is something of an expert on the subject.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.player: I can't even communicate with the monkeys!

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor.text: Just go and find my squad mage, human.

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor-again.speaker: Garkor
chapter-2-talking-to-garkor-again.text: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?

chapter-2-talking-to-garkor-again.speaker: Garkor

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Hello?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: A human... here? What business have you on Ape Atoll?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: I am on a mission for King Narnode Shareen of the Gnomes.
Hello?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: A human... here? What business have you on Ape Atoll?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: I am on a mission for King Narnode Shareen of the Gnomes.
I have been sent to investigate the whereabouts of the 10th squad of his Royal Guard, which went missing during a recent mission to Karamja.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Well you've found us - what's left of us, that is.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: I am Zooknock, the 10th squad mage. These are Bunkwicket and Waymottin, two of our finest sappers. I assume you will want to know how we got here?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Of course.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Your story first, human. What possessed you to travel to this forsaken island?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: I am currently in the service of your King. I was the human who exposed Glough's warfaring plans and defeated his demon.
As far as I understand, the 10th squad were sent to oversee the decommission of Glough's shipyard in east Karamja.
Rumour has it you were blown off course. The King worried as to your fate, and sent me to investigate.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: You were sent alone?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: No, I have been accompanied by Flight Commander Waydar. We flew south on a special type of glider and landed on a small island to our east.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: The so called Crash Island. We left there one of our number, Lumdo, to guard our gliders until our return.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Yes, we have met. He ferried me across to the atoll.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: He did!? He was explicitly ordered to guard the gliders! How did this happen? Who is guarding the gliders now?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Waydar ordered him to leave his post. He is guarding the gliders himself.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Flight Commander Waydar you said? For some reason that name is familiar...

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: So why are you here?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: The rumours are correct. We were indeed blown off course. Fortunately, we managed to find a small island to steer our gliders towards, else we surely would have drowned.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Then you gathered enough wood to fashion two boats. Your Sergeant and the rest of the 10th squad took the larger boat to this island, leaving Lumdo to guard the gliders and the other boat...

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Correct. I assume Lumdo told you this?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Yes. What happened when you landed here?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We split up into several small groups to search the island for potential gnome glider launch sites. Whilst we knew the island to be inhabited, we did not expect its occupants to be quite so ... militant.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Monkeys. Lots of monkeys. They are unlike any other type of monkey we've come across. A far cry from the usual wild variety, these were armed with high quality weaponry and uncanny tactical ability.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We were overwhelmed in numbers. Some of us managed to escape, but the rest were taken captive.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Who survived?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Myself, the Sergeant, Bunkwicket and Waymottin here. Karam, our assassin, probably managed to escape - he usually does.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: And of the rest?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado were captured, as I said. We believe they are being held in the jail. We are working on a way to release them. I have sensed there lies a cavern to the north.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We are attempting to tunnel to this northern cavern and then move upwards from there.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Why don't you just go overground?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We have considered this, but every entrance seems to be excessively guarded.
Before talking to Sergeant Garkor:
After talking to Sergeant Garkor:

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: I see.
I have spoken to your Sergeant. He believes that the best way to rescue the rest of your squad with the minimum of casualties is to have an insider - a monkey working for us.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Aha. He wants me to turn you into a monkey.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Actually, it was more along the lines of a disguise...

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: I think you misunderstand, human. Do you know why you were sent here?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: King Narnode Shareen asked me to...

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Indeed. However, King Narnode Shareen is still in contact with Garkor! You were sent here because Garkor specifically asked Narnode for you!

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Why wasn't I told?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Before you arrived on this island, that information would have endangered both yourself and the mission.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: But why a human? Why me?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Garkor had long decided that we need a monkey insider. I have the necessary magic to perform the shapeshifting spell, but we needed a human to transform.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Why don't you just transform a gnome?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: It has been tried in the past, but the results were far from ... satisfactory. Although we, like you, are related to the monkeys, the link is too weak for a successful transformation. That is why we need you.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: Right. What do I have to do?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: There will be two aspects to your transformation. We must first arrange it so that you are able to understand and communicate with the monkeys.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: We must also transform your body so that you may pass amongst them unnoticed.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: So that the effects of my spells are not permanent, I will invest their power into magical items which you must find. You can then use them at your will.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.player: What kind of items?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: For the spells to take full effect, they will have to be in some way related to the monkeys.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: I suggest that I invest the ability to communicate with the monkeys in an authentic monkey amulet.

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock.text: Similarly, the transformation spell should be stored in a monkey talisman of some kind.

options.text: Where do I find a monkey amulet mould?

chapter-2-talking-to-zooknock-talking-to.text: Slow, as ever. Can't you tell?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I am afraid I have not been able to fully invest my powers in that talisman. You may use it, but it will continue to draw its energy directly from me.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: The range at which I will be able to sustain it is limited. I cannot ensure it will be effective off the atoll.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Furthermore, you will not be able to attack whilst using this, so be careful. Perhaps when I refine my spells I could look into making this possible.
