chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: It is good of you to meet me, Waydar.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: It is good to see you again, Caranock. It is a strange island these monkeys inhabit.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Well observed. How have you been keeping yourself occupied?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I am now a Flight Commander. My duties include testing Glough's prototype military glider.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: My my. How things have changed somewhat since Glough's time... Now, what of the human?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: The human? Just somebody Narnode appears to have taken a fancy to. It is hard to tell why. I suspect the human was involved with Glough's fall from grace.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: You may be right. Never mind - there are greater matters afoot. With Glough gone, it falls to us to continue with his plans.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Also, the shipyard workers are becoming restless.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I see. What do you have in mind?

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Money for me, Waydar, and promotion for you. As you know, the 10th squad of the Royal Guard are slightly worse for wear on this island.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: This I know. But I don't see how it leads to money or promotion.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: What if they were to die? An entire squad of the Royal Guard goes missing in the jungle of Karamja ... We could blame it on the humans.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Narnode would be furious!

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Precisely. He might even order an invasion. At the very least he'll step up the defence. More orders for me, promotion for you.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Very clever. It might also serve us well to remind Narnode of Bolren's situation.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Ah yes - all that trouble with the Khazard. Last I heard, Bolren had retrieved the orbs of protection. Apparently some human lent their assistance.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Really? Typical meddling human behaviour. Nevertheless, it will stoke fires of worry. After all, the battle still continues.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: I agree. Anyhow, we don't want your human wondering as to your whereabouts. When the time is right, don't hesitate to ... dispose of it.

chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.speaker: Waydar
chapter-2-creating-the-monkey-gree-gree-.text: Understood. Military gliders are after all an untested form of transport...
Monkey Madness: Chapter 3 In which our hero finds themselves contending with life as a monkey.

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Careless human. No matter - bring me the same materials again and I will prepare for you another one.

options.text: Can you make another monkey talisman?

steps.player: Can you make another monkey talisman?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.speaker: Zooknock
steps.text: Very well. Bring me the required materials again and I will prepare for you another one.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard-earl.player: Oh nothing ... I'm just passing by.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.text: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.player: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-not-di.text: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.text: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
If the player is not transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: However, you look like the wrong sort of monkey. My plan requires that you look like one of the monkeys of mainland Karamja.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: When the time comes, you are to pretend you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and that you are seeking an alliance.

steps.player: How do you know this will work?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: As I said, I've been listening to Awowogei for some time now. Come back when you look like one of the Karamjan monkeys.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-while-disgui.text: If the player is transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.text: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-talking-to-garkor-again-after-.text: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.text: What brings you up here, monkey?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-early.text: You would do better to explore elsewhere - we are extremely busy at the moment.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.player: I'd like to speak with Awowogei, please.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.speaker: Elder Guard
chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.text: Only the Captain of the Monkey Guard or those he authorises may enter this building. You will need his permission to enter.

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.player: Who is the Captain of the Monkey Guard?

chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.speaker: Elder Guard
chapter-3-talking-to-an-elder-guard.text: He goes by the name of Kruk.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: What brings you up here, monkey?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.player: I have come to seek audience with Awowogei. I am told I need your permission to do so.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: That's right - you do. What business have you on our island?

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.player: I am envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. I have come to propose an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: If the player is transformed into the wrong monkey:

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: I don't believe you. You don't look much like any Karamja monkey I've seen.

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: Stop wasting my time.

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk.text: If the player is transformed into a Karamjan monkey:

steps.speaker: Kruk
steps.text: I see. Very well, you look genuine enough. Follow me.
Screen fades in and out. The player is now in Awowogei's throne room.

chapter-3-talking-to-uwogo.speaker: Uwogo
chapter-3-talking-to-uwogo.text: Get away from me, you foul commoner!

chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-2.speaker: Kruk
chapter-3-talking-to-kruk-2.text: Sorry, I am far too busy dealing with the invaders right now.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: Greetings, visitor. What brings you to my island?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: I am an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. We wish to propose an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I see. Ours is a strong and mighty lineage of monkey, visitor. We clearly do not need your offer of an alliance.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: Awowogei, please consider my offer carefully.
We offer strength in numbers and our island would serve as a northern platform for defence. All that we ask for in return is peace.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Uwogo
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I don't believe him, Awowogei. Never trust a northern monkey.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Muruwoi
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I think he seems trustworthy, sir.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I must admit, I have always regarded your kind as our inferior cousins, visitor.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: However, I am well aware that you may have a few things to offer.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: I have heard your kind are exceptionally resourceful. I wish to put this reputation to the test.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: You must be well aware your kind are hunted and trapped almost everywhere.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: In particular you may have heard of such activities in a city known to the humans as Ardougne.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: There are several of your kind kept captive there. I challenge you to free one and return it to me.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: How am I meant to free one of them?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.text: This is for you to decide, visitor.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei.player: Very well. I will be back later, with one of the captives.

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.text: Have you brought with you a captive?

chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-talking-to-awowogei-again-befo.text: Then hurry, visitor. I am beginning to lose my faith in you.

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: Why do you monkeys keep trying to escape? Good thing I've caught you before you got away, you little scoundrel.

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: Let's put you back in your cage where you belong...

chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-getting-captured-by-the-monkey.text: I must be imagining things ... monkeys can't talk.

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: How would you like to get out of here?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Escape!? It's all I ever think about!

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: That's convenient. When would you like to leave?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Where will you be taking me?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: Erm ... to the happy, sunny jungle of Karamja...

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Wowee! I was born there you know!

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: That's nice. Are you ready to go?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Yes. Actually, can I bring some of my friends?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: No, I only have space for one.

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.speaker: Monkey
chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.text: Pretty please with a banana on top?

chapter-3-talking-to-a-monkey-in-the-cag.player: Look, I already said no. If you want to come then jump into my backpack.

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.text: My word - what are you doing in there?

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.player: I ... er ... I don't know! One minute I was asleep, and the next minute I was here surrounded by monkeys!

chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.speaker: Monkey minder
chapter-3-escaping-the-cage.text: Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: Have you brought with you a captive?

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: You have shown yourself to be very resourceful. You have managed to complete an extremely long journey remarkably quickly.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: You are clearly well acquainted with the ways of this world. We will talk more on this later.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: In the meantime, feel free to remain as long as you like on my island.

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.player: What about the proposed alliance, Awowogei?

chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-bringing-awowogei-a-monkey.text: I must think upon it some more and discuss the matter with my advisers. We will contact you when we are ready.

steps.speaker: King Awowogei
steps.text: We are still pondering your proposition...We will let you know when we have an answer...

chapter-3-talking-to-muruwoi-after-bring.speaker: Muruwoi
chapter-3-talking-to-muruwoi-after-bring.text: Well done on retrieving the captive, visitor. Awowogei was impressed.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: However, your efforts may be in vain...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.player: Who was speaking? What was said?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Garkor
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
Somewhere far below the Ape Atoll...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Good evening, Awowogei.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: It is always dark here, Gnome. Why have you asked to see me in private?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Caranock and I have a suggestion to make.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Then be quick about it.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: The foot soldiers of the Royal Guard in your jail...

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Would it not be easier if they were somehow just to ... die?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Why would I want to do that? Your king would declare war on my island.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: I can assure you he will not. We will lay the blame at the humans' feet.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Narnode will indeed declare war: not against you, but against humankind.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: You are of course welcome to your share of the profits.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Intriguing. I have recently secured an alliance with the northern monkeys, which may prove useful.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What would you have me do?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Kill the foot soldiers and the rest of the 10th squad. My superior has sent you a few tricks which may prove useful.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Such as?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: High magic: the ability to summon the entire 10th squad to a single location. And -

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Even those who escaped?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Yes. And of course, you will also receive access to one of his 'pets'.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: You must be careful with these, as you have only one use of each. Ensure you set your trap well - none must survive lest they spread the truth.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Waydar
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What of my human?

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: What human??

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Ignore [him/her/them]. My colleague's official mission was to look after a human in the area, but don't worry: it is probably dead already.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: I should hope so, for both of your sakes.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Very well. I shall let you know when I have dealt with the Royal Guard.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: G.L.O. Caranock
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: Good luck, Awowogei.

chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.speaker: Awowogei
chapter-3-returning-to-garkor.text: With access to one of Glough's 'pets', I don't think I'll need it...
Monkey Madness: Chapter 4 The Final Battle

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.

chapter-4.player: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.

chapter-4.player: But how will I join you?

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes the spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
Garkor hands you some kind of medallion.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.

chapter-4.player: All I have to do is wear this sigil?

chapter-4.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4.text: Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear our squad sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.

options.text: What kind of enemy do we face?

steps.player: What kind of enemy do we face?

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: I don't know. I truly don't know.

options.condition: If the player lost the 10th squad sigil:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: For all your power, your kind are exceptionally foolish. You must seek out Waymottin and ask him to make a replica. I have no spares.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't you see I'm busy?

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't talk now.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: I'm too busy to talk, sorry.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.player: Sergeant Garkor has sent me. You are asked to create another replica of the 10th squad sigil so that I may join you for the final battle.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.speaker: Waymottin
chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.text: Already made one. Figured it would come in handy.

chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.speaker: Bunkwicket
chapter-4-talking-to-waymottin-without-a.text: He's cleverer than he looks, is that Waymottin.
Waymottin hands you a replica of the squad sigil.

chapter-4-equipping-the-sigil.prompt: Let the sigil teleport you when worn?

steps.text: The 10th squad sigil begins to shake violently!
A cutscene begins as the screen starts to shake. The camera slowly zooms out from the giant monkey statue in the underground banana plantation.
First time:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
Subsequent times:

steps.speaker: Garkor
steps.text: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins... again!

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Well done, human! For a second there, I thought we would fail.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Indeed we did - and with no casualties either.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.player: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?

chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.speaker: Garkor
chapter-4-talking-to-garkor-after-killin.text: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.

chapter-4-talking-to-bonzara.speaker: Bonzara
chapter-4-talking-to-bonzara.text: It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: Right you are.
The player gets teleported to the surface of Ape Atoll.

steps.player: No thank you. Who are you by the way?

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.

steps.player: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.

steps.speaker: Bonzara
steps.text: We WILL meet again, [player name].

chapter-4-talking-to-zooknock.speaker: Zooknock
chapter-4-talking-to-zooknock.text: Well done, human. Bear with me now.
The player is teleported out of the banana plantation

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes? How is the mission going ... it has been quite some time since I sent you on your way.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes, alright. Report on what happened.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.player: With all due respect sir, if I told you, you would not believe me. I expect Sergeant Garkor will be sending you a full report soon enough.
They all live - we suffered no casualties.
I, uh, I'm part of the 10th squad now. I even have the sigil.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: You show King Narnode your sigil.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Well, now. It appears I cannot argue with that. Garkor obviously thinks highly of you, as do I.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: No service such as what you have done for me goes unrewarded in my kingdom. I personally made a visit to the Royal Treasury to withdraw your reward.
King Narnode hands you a huge stack of gold coins and several diamonds!

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: So you're officially a member of the 10th squad then?

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Well then you had better sign up for training.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: Yes. All members of the Royal Guard must complete a mandatory training programme.

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.player: Where do I sign up for this?

chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
chapter-4-returning-to-king-narnode.text: The High Tree Guardian Daero is in charge of the training programme. You should know where to find him by now.

post-quest-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
post-quest-king-narnode.text: Good of you to stop by, human.

post-quest-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
post-quest-king-narnode.text: Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Monkey Madness II quest.

options.text: I want to sign up for the training programme.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Hello there. I hear your mission is complete.

steps.player: News travels quickly on this tree. I expect you also know that I am to be enrolled in the Royal Guard training programme.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Indeed I do.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: For you, it should hardly take any time at all.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: Enthusiasm. I like that. We will first begin with a series of exercises designed to increase your strength and stamina.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: We then will follow these up by improving your attack and defence techniques.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You will improve your strength, stamina, attack and defence, but you may choose what you want to focus on.

options.text: Focus on increasing strength and stamina...

steps.text: Several hours later...

options.text: Focus on improving attack and defence techniques...

steps.text: Several hours later...

options.text: I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.player: I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.speaker: Daero
steps.text: You know the routine...
You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The screen fades to black and the player is taken to the secret hangar.

post-quest-glough.speaker: Glough
post-quest-glough.text: This isn't the last you'll see of me, human. Mark my words - the monkeys are listening.

post-quest-lumo.player: How did you get back in there?

post-quest-lumo.speaker: Lumo
post-quest-lumo.text: Yes. We are working undercover here. Isn't that right, guys?

post-quest-carado.speaker: Carado
post-quest-carado.text: Well I'm not complaining - this jail cell is larger than my room in the Grand Tree! It is a little sparse however...

post-quest-carado.player: We'll get you out of there soon enough.

post-quest-carado.speaker: Carado
post-quest-carado.text: I'm meant to be here now. We're working undercover.

post-quest-garkor.speaker: Garkor
post-quest-garkor.text: My squad and I are to remain on this island as undercover operatives. I am collecting information on Awowogei and his policies.

post-quest-karam.speaker: Karam
post-quest-karam.text: My squad and I are to remain on this island in secret. The monkeys think we are trying to break our friends out of the jail, but we are just biding our time.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't you see I'm busy?

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: Can't talk now.

steps.speaker: Waymottin
steps.text: I'm too busy to talk, sorry.

post-quest-waymottin.speaker: Waymottin
post-quest-waymottin.text: But if you ever lose your sigil, let me know.
